task.title: P6-146: Fix RowSet::key missing Place::meta and section delimiter
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, ⌘K palette and quick-add). Original id: P6-146. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`RowSet::key` omits `Place::meta` and has no section delimiter** (was `P6-030a` + `P6-030b`; `palette.rs:954-968`). A collection reparented while the palette is open keeps its stale parent-path meta (`Rares — Shoebox` after it moved under Trade Binder); and the key concatenates place `token`+`name` and command `slug` with one `\u{1f}` separator and no marker between the two spaces, so a collision needs a collection literally named `new-binder`/`new-deck`/`undo-last-move` — unlikely, but a section marker costs nothing.
